description.value: Errington General is a rural convenience and general store operated by the Wayne Procter Group, a long-standing Vancouver Island retail company. It functions as a Rural Agency Store serving the Errington community and offers a deli with hot food alongside convenience staples, propane, and an ATM. For a touring cyclist riding the Island, it represents a useful resupply and hot-meal stop in an otherwise rural stretch.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for Errington General (part of the Wayne Procter Group) provides a clear amenity list including 'Deli with hot food,' 'Auto and cylinder propane,' 'Tank exchange program,' and 'ATM,' confirming hot food and camping fuel (propane). The store is tagged as shop=convenience in OSM and is actively listed as an operating location; no bike-specific amenities (parking, rack, pump, water) are mentioned anywhere on the site. OSM carries no address or phone, but the website supplies the street address.
concerns: Street address from website reads '1544 Grafon Ave' — 'Grafon' may be a typo for 'Grafton'; worth verifying against a local map.
No store-specific phone number found; corporate Wayne Procter Group number (250-753-2540) is for HQ in Nanaimo, not the store directly.
OSM record contains no address, phone, or website tag — all contact data sourced from the discovered URL only.
Bike parking and water refill could not be confirmed or denied; an on-site visit would resolve both.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active rural general store with groceries, hot deli food, and propane on Vancouver Island; a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists with sufficient amenity evidence to justify listing.
